title: 肯尼亚 visceral leishmaniasis 诊断中 rK28 和 rK39 快速检测盒的性能评估及国家算法优化建议
originalTitle: Diagnostic performance of rK28- and rK39-based rapid diagnostic tests for Visceral Leishmaniasis in Kenya: Implications for the national diagnostic algorithm
summary: 肯尼亚研究显示，rK28快速诊断盒在 visceral leishmaniasis 诊断中敏感性达96%，但rK39特异性更高（93%）但敏感性较低（67%）。
